title: Pizza Dough
description: Chewy, crispy, restaurant quality. Adapted from Serious Eats / Kenji López-Alt.
steps: Add water and oil. Mix until dough forms.
Knead until smooth and elastic, 8-10 minutes.
Place in oiled bowl. Cover, let rise until doubled, 1-2 hours.
Use immediately or refrigerate up to 3 days.
Let cold dough come to room temp before shaping.

To bake: set a pizza stone, steel or upside-down sheet pan on a rack and heat the oven to its hottest setting (500-550°F) for 45 minutes. Stretch a dough ball, top lightly, and bake 8-12 minutes until the crust is browned and the cheese bubbles.
notes: Bread flour has more gluten for chewy texture.
High heat is essential for crispy crust.
source: Adapted from Serious Eats / Kenji López-Alt
